name: Tobiah
overview: Tobiah appears in Scripture both as an ancestor of Babylonian captives and as a significant adversary during Nehemiah's efforts to rebuild Jerusalem's walls. As an Ammonite and ally of Sanballat, Tobiah opposed the restoration work, mocking the builders and conspiring to intimidate and harm Nehemiah and the Jewish people. His opposition extended to political subversion, including alliances with influential figures such as Eliashib the priest, highlighting the spiritual and physical challenges faced in the community's covenant renewal and city restoration.
